title: ServiceNow and Anthropic Disclose AI Deal
content:
# ServiceNow 和 Anthropic 公布人工智能合作协议
通过此次合作，Anthropic 将更深入地进入企业人工智能市场。
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), 特约撰稿人
2026 年 1 月 30 日
阅读需 2 分钟
![移动设备上的 ServiceNow 标志图片](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf88ddd6d7f917822/697cc6a6822c19dae9c8889f/ServiceNow.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Getty Images
在与 OpenAI 达成协议一周后，ServiceNow 与 Anthropic 达成协议，将生成式人工智能供应商 Claude 模型嵌入到其跨行业的流程中，包括医疗保健和生命科学。
根据 1 月 28 日公布的协议，[Claude](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics/news/366637160/Claude-for-Healthcare-launches) 也将成为 [IT 服务供应商的人工智能代理构建器](https://aibusiness.com/agentic-ai/servicenow-unveils-ai-experience-agentic-features) ServiceNow Build Agent 的默认模型，该模型使任何技能水平的开发人员都能够创建和部署可以自主行动和推理的代理工作流程。
该协议还包括将 Claude 推广到 ServiceNow 的 29,000 名员工，ServiceNow 将向工程师和技术团队提供 Anthropic 的人工智能驱动的编码助手 [Claude Code](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/anthropic-out-with-claude-opus-4-5)。
ServiceNow 首席执行官 Bill McDermott 在一份声明中表示：“ServiceNow 与 Anthropic 正在通过面向全球最大企业的人工智能原生工作流程将智能转化为行动。此次合作……让每个人、每个行业、每个级别的人都能构建、部署和扩展关键任务应用程序。”
Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 在声明中表示，企业经常犯的一个错误是将人工智能视为一种独立的工具，而不是将其嵌入到日常工作中，随着公司寻求扩大人工智能部署，这一点将变得越来越重要。
他说：“获得更好结果的方法是将人工智能作为完成工作不可或缺的一部分——融入到员工每天所做的所有事情中。”
该协议是支持代理人工智能和自主运营日益增长的重点的一部分，并且是在 ServiceNow 最近与 Anthropic 的竞争对手 OpenAI 建立 [合作关系](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership) 之后达成的。
在该协议中，ServiceNow 将把 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.2 模型嵌入到其平台中，以为 IT、人力资源和客户服务等功能提供自主人工智能代理。
该合资企业还加入了 Anthropic 的一系列交易，Anthropic 最近与 [全球保险公司 Allianz](https://www.reinsurancene.ws/allianz-partners-with-anthropic-to-accelerate-adoption-of-responsible-ai/) 以及埃森哲、IBM、德勤和 Snowflake 达成了协议，以扩大其大型语言模型的覆盖范围。
## 关于作者
特约撰稿人
Scarlett Evans 是一位自由撰稿人，专注于新兴技术和矿产行业。此前，她曾在 IoT World Today 担任助理编辑，专门研究机器人技术和智慧城市技术。Scarlett 还拥有采矿和资源领域的背景，曾在 Mine Australia、Mine Technology 和 Power Technology 工作过。她在 2022 年 4 月加入 Informa，之后转为自由职业。

# ServiceNow and Anthropic Disclose AI Deal
With the partnership, Anthropic moves deeper into the enterprise AI market.
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), Contributing Writer
January 30, 2026
2 Min Read
![Pic of ServiceNow logo on mobile](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf88ddd6d7f917822/697cc6a6822c19dae9c8889f/ServiceNow.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Getty Images
A week after it forged a deal with OpenAI, ServiceNow entered into an agreement with Anthropic to embed the generative AI vendor's Claude models in its workflows across industries, including healthcare and life sciences.
Under the deal, revealed on Jan. 28, [Claude](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics/news/366637160/Claude-for-Healthcare-launches) will also be he default model for the [IT service vendor's AI agent builder,](https://aibusiness.com/agentic-ai/servicenow-unveils-ai-experience-agentic-features) ServiceNow Build Agent, which enables developers of any skill level to create and deploy agentic workflows that can act and reason autonomously.
The deal also includes the rollout of Claude to ServiceNow’s workforce of 29,000 employees, and ServiceNow will provide Anthropic’s AI-powered coding assistant [Claude Code](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/anthropic-out-with-claude-opus-4-5) to engineers and technical teams.
“ServiceNow with Anthropic is turning intelligence into action through AI-native workflows for the world’s largest enterprises,” ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott said in a release. This partnership … puts the power to build, deploy, and scale mission-critical applications into the hands of every person, in every industry, at every level.”
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said in the release that enterprises often make the mistake of treating AI as a standalone tool rather than embedding it into day-to-day work, something that will become increasingly important as companies look to ramp up AI deployments.
“The way to get much better results is to make AI an integral part of how you get work done -- woven into the whole range of things workers do every day,” he said.
The deal comes as part of a growing focus on supporting agentic AI and autonomous operations and follows ServiceNow’s recent [partnership with Anthropic rival OpenAI](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership).
In that deal, ServiceNow will embed OpenAI’s GPT-5.2 model into its platform to power autonomous AI agents for functions such as IT, HR, and customer service.
The venture also joins a spate of deals for Anthropic, which recently forged agreements with [global insurer Allianz](https://www.reinsurancene.ws/allianz-partners-with-anthropic-to-accelerate-adoption-of-responsible-ai/), as well as Accenture, IBM, Deloitte, and Snowflake, as it expands the reach of its large language models.

title: Google DeepMind Introduces Agentic Vision to Gemini 3 Flash
content:
# Google DeepMind 将 Agentic Vision 引入 Gemini 3 Flash

新功能将视觉推理与 Python 代码相结合，以改进图像分析并实现主动调查。

[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), 特约撰稿人

2026 年 1 月 29 日

阅读 1 分钟

![ Google DeepMind 位于英国伦敦的办公室](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltb05e3cce6a80ec32/697be1d456130b4cb37e3ad9/deepmind.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)

Dan Kitwood/Staff via Getty Images

Google DeepMind 本周将 Agentic Vision 功能添加到 Gemini 3 Flash 模型中，将图像分析变成一项主动而非被动的任务。

虽然典型的多模态模型以“一瞥”的方式处理图像，但通过引入 Agentic 功能，Google 允许其模型主动研究图片并专注于特定细节，例如街道标志或微芯片上的序列号。

新功能通过生成和运行 Python 代码来实现，这些代码可以有条不紊地缩放、操作和检查图像。

Google DeepMind 产品经理 Rohan Doshi 在一篇关于该公告的[博客文章](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/agentic-vision-gemini-3-flash/)中写道：“通过将视觉推理与代码执行相结合，Agentic Vision 支持的首批工具之一，该模型制定计划以逐步放大、检查和操作图像，从而将答案建立在视觉证据的基础上。”

该功能使用“思考-行动-观察”循环，Gemini 3 Flash 将研究用户查询和图像并制定计划，使用 Python 代码主动进行图像分析，然后检查结果，最后生成最终响应。

据 Google 称，此次更新使视觉基准的质量提高了 5% 到 10%。

Google 表示，通过 Google AI Studio，已经展示了一系列新的 Agentic 行为，例如迭代缩放、直接图像注释和视觉绘图。据说后者可以减少幻觉——视觉数学任务中常见的问题。

展望未来，该公司表示计划在该模型中添加更多隐式代码驱动的行为，这意味着某些当前需要特定提示的功能将成为一项自主功能。

# Google DeepMind Introduces Agentic Vision to Gemini 3 Flash
The new capabilities combine visual reasoning with Python code to improve image analysis and enable active investigations.
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), Contributing Writer
January 29, 2026
1 Min Read
![ Google DeepMind offices in London, England](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltb05e3cce6a80ec32/697be1d456130b4cb37e3ad9/deepmind.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Dan Kitwood/Staff via Getty Images
Google DeepMind added this week agentic vision capabilities to its Gemini 3 Flash model, turning image analysis an active rather than passive task.
While typical multimodal models process images in a single "glance," by introducing agentic capabilities, Google allows its model to actively study a picture and home in on specific details, such as street signs or a serial number on a microchip.
The new feature works by generating and running Python code that zooms, manipulates and inspects images methodically.
"By combining visual reasoning with code execution, one of the first tools supported by Agentic Vision, the model formulates plans to zoom in, inspect and manipulate images step-by-step, grounding answers in visual evidence," Rohan Doshi, product manager at Google DeepMind, wrote in a [blog post](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/agentic-vision-gemini-3-flash/) about the announcement.
The feature uses a Think-Act-Observe loop, whereby Gemini 3 Flash will study a user query and image and formulate a plan, use Python code to actively conduct an image analysis, and then inspect the results before generating its final response.
According to Google, the update saw a quality improvement of between 5% to 10% across vision benchmarks.
A range of new agentic behaviors have, Google said, already been demonstrated from the update via Google AI Studio, such as iterative zooming, direct image annotation and visual plotting. The latter is said to reduce hallucinations ­— a common problem with visual math tasks.
Looking ahead, the company said it plans to add more implicit code-driven behaviors into the model, meaning certain capabilities that currently require a specific prompt will become an autonomous feature.
